topic_zh: 延迟和吞吐量：不是一回事
topic_en: Latency vs throughput: not the same thing

xhs.title: 系统变快了？先问是哪种快
xhs.body:
延迟：一个请求要等多久，单位是毫秒。
吞吐量：一秒能完成多少个请求。
就像高速公路：加车道，每小时过的车多了，但每辆车还是要开那么久。
批量写入也一样：吞吐涨 10 倍，每条的延迟一点没少，还要多等凑批。
考考你：1 台服务器每个请求 50 毫秒、每秒 100 个，加到 4 台一样的（平均分、不排队），每个请求延迟是 A 50 毫秒还是 B 12.5 毫秒？评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: More lanes = more cars per hour, not a faster trip. Quiz: 1 server, 50 ms per request. Add 3 identical servers, no queueing. Latency: A) 50 ms or B) 12.5 ms?

linkedin.title: Higher throughput does not mean lower latency.
linkedin.body:
Latency: how long one request takes. Throughput: how many requests finish per second.
Adding lanes to a highway moves more cars per hour, but each trip takes just as long.
Batching disk writes works the same way: 10x the throughput, and each write still waits, plus the time for the batch to fill.
Before you optimize, say which one you need.
Quiz: 1 server, 50 ms per request, 100 req/s. Add 3 identical servers, split evenly, no queueing. Per-request latency: A) 50 ms or B) 12.5 ms?

quiz.q_zh: 1 台服务器每个请求 50 毫秒、每秒 100 个；再加 3 台一样的（平均分、不排队），每个请求的延迟是 A 50 毫秒还是 B 12.5 毫秒？
quiz.q_en: 1 server: 50 ms per request, 100 req/s. Add 3 identical servers, split evenly, no queueing. Per-request latency: A) 50 ms or B) 12.5 ms?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：A，50 毫秒。加机器是多开车道：吞吐最多变成每秒 400 个，但每个请求还是要处理 50 毫秒。如果原来请求在排队，加机器能缩短排队等待，但处理本身的 50 毫秒不会变。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A, 50 ms. More servers are more lanes: throughput goes up to 400 req/s, but each request still takes 50 ms. If requests were queueing, more servers would cut the queue wait, but not the 50 ms of work.
